findings.title: Invalidate connected calendar queries after deleting cached data
findings.body: The delete-cache mutation only shows a toast and calls the optional onSuccess callback; it never invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. The wrapper passes props.onChanged directly, which is optional and does not itself refresh the wrapper's query, and that query disables refetchOnWindowFocus. Consequently, a successful deletion can leave the old cache timestamp and Delete cached data action visible even though the cache no longer exists. Invalidate the connected-calendar queries on success, as the disconnect mutation already does, so all scopes display the updated cache status.
